name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl,  Halpern,  Mayor  Pro  Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES: None

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  2025 Cecilia DePippo Kindness Award Presentation – Ryan and Emily
  Capretta, Proactive Sports

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – REVIEW OF LANDSCAPE
  ASSESSMENT DISTRICT 1 - City Council to receive the information regarding
  Landscape Assessment District 1 and provide comments and guidance to staff.

2.  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE REPORT – PURE WATER PROJECT
  UPDATE – City Council to receive the information regarding the Pure Water
  Project in anticipation of upcoming study session on this topic.
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 88-001, MODIFICATION NO. 1;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2419-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2419-25 determining Planned
  Development Permit No. 88-001, Modification No.1 is exempt from CEQA and
  authorizing a change in exterior colors to an existing commercial center located at
  32107-32133 Lindero Canyon Road (The Landing).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2419-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 88-
  001, MODIFICATION NO. 1 AUTHORIZING A MODIFICATION TO EXTERIOR
  BUILDING COLORS AT AN EXISTING COMMERCIAL CENTER LOCATED AT 32107-
  32133 LINDERO CANYON ROAD (THE LANDING)

2.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 25-003; RESOLUTION NO. 2420-25 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2420-25 determining Conditional Use Permit No. 25-003 is exempt
  from CEQA and authorizing the conversion of an existing commercial tenant space
  into an indoor children’s play and event facility, including a small cafe located at
  31166 Via Colinas (Posh & Petite).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2420-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO.
  25-003 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONVERSION OF AN EXISTING COMMERCIAL
  TENANT SPACE INTO AN INDOOR CHILDREN’S PLAY AND EVENT FACILITY,
  INCLUDING A SMALL CAFÉ AT 31166 VIA COLINAS (POSH & PETITE)

3.  SIGN MODIFICATION PERMIT NO. 25-008; RESOLUTION NO. 2421-25 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2421-25 determining Sign Modification Permit No. 25-008 is
  exempt from CEQA and authorizing the installation of a monument sign at 31111
  Agoura Road (Conejo Health).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2421-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING SIGN MODIFICATION PERMIT NO. 25-008
  FOR A 6.83-FOOT BY 2.50-FOOT EXTERNALLY ILLUMINATED SIGN ON AN
  EXISTING MONUMENT SIGN AT 31111 AGOURA ROAD (CONEJO HEALTH)

4.  SIGN MODIFICATION PERMIT NO. 25-009; RESOLUTION NO. 2422-25 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2422-25 determining Sign Modification Permit No. 25-009 is
  exempt from CEQA and authorizing the installation of a wall sign at 4360 Park
  Terrace Drive (Caldera Medical).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2422-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING SIGN MODIFICATION PERMIT NO. 25-009
  AUTHORIZING A 15.16-FOOT BY 3.60-FOOT HALO-ILLUMINATED, CHANNEL
  LETTER WALL SIGN AT 4360 PARK TERRACE DRIVE (CALDERA MEDICAL)
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS:  Warrants effective November 1, 2025 in the
  amount of $928,113.85

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ACCEPTANCE OF EASEMENT FOR SEWER PURPOSES AND
  SUMMARY VACATION OF EXISTING SEWER EASEMENT AT 5388
  STERLING CENTER DRIVE RESOLUTION NO. 2423-25 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2423-25 authorizing the acceptance of an easement for
  sewer purposes and the summary vacation of a portion of the city’s existing
  sewer easement at the property located at 5388 Sterling Center Drive.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2423-25: RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE OF AN
  EASEMENT FOR SEWER PURPOSES AND THE SUMMARY VACATION OF A
  PORTION OF THE CITY’S EXISTING SEWER EASEMENT AT THE PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 5388 STERLING CENTER DRIVE

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO DASH CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC. FOR
  THE ANNUAL STREET RESURFACING PROJECT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-
  26 - Award a construction contract for the Annual Street Resurfacing Project for
  the Fiscal Year 2025-26 to DASH in the amount of $1,194,131.80; authorize the
  City Manager to approve change orders up to the 15% contingency amount; and
  authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the construction contract on behalf of the
  City.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR THE
  CITY HALL RESTROOM REHABILITATION PROJECT, PHASE 1 - Adopt the
  plans and specifications for the City Hall Restroom Rehabilitation Project and
  authorize staff to advertise bids for the Civic Center Restroom Rehabilitation
  Project – Phase 1.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, November 7, 2025 at 12:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  November 7, 2025
